Black Salt Powder for Wholesale and Export

Black salt powder, known in India as kala namak, is a speciality salt with a savoury, slightly eggy aroma. Food manufacturers, spice blenders, retailers and importers ask us for a fair black salt powder price on regular supply, and Tradenest Naturals ships it from India to buyers worldwide. The product has the typical sulphurous aroma, distinctive salty taste and fine texture of traditional Indian kala namak. We also offer bulk supply, private label packing and customer-specific specifications. Kala namak is sometimes sold as Himalayan black salt. It is widely used in South Asian cooking and increasingly in modern seasoning work. Despite the name, the fine powder is usually pinkish grey, violet grey or light purple. Its aroma comes from naturally occurring sulphur compounds, which give an egg-like savoury note that ordinary table salt cannot match. Tradenest Naturals is a bulk black salt powder supplier India importers, distributors, food brands, restaurants and ingredient buyers can work with directly. We look at every enquiry individually, so you get clear guidance on grade, mesh size, packing, documents and order volume before production begins.

Product Overview

Our black salt powder is made from carefully selected black salt from trusted suppliers. The salt is cleaned, fine milled and sieved under controlled conditions, then packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant material. Good packing matters here, because salt picks up moisture easily during storage and sea freight. The powder dissolves quickly in water-based recipes and blends evenly into dry seasonings. Its savoury sulphur note is valued in snacks, chutneys, fruit preparations, raitas, sauces, spice blends and vegan products. Buyers can take our standard grade or ask about a different particle size for a specific line.

Typical Product Specifications

  • Product type: Fine black salt powder (kala namak powder)
  • Processing: Fine milled and sieved
  • Mesh size: 80-100 mesh
  • Moisture: Not more than 2.0%
  • Appearance: Pinkish grey to violet grey fine powder
  • Flavour: Salty, mildly sulphurous and savoury
  • Form: Free-flowing powder with controlled particle size
  • Additives: No added colour or flavour unless specifically requested
Values can vary slightly with the source material and the destination market's requirements. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and we confirm the final specification before accepting an order. Samples are available for evaluation.

Processing Method

Our process is built around cleanliness, uniform particle size and easy bulk handling. We start by selecting suitable black salt from approved supply channels. The raw material is inspected for visible foreign matter and unsuitable lumps. The salt is then cleaned and prepared for milling. Controlled fine milling produces an even powder, which is sieved to the agreed 80-100 mesh range. The finished batch is inspected and packed in suitable food-grade packaging. Tradenest Naturals keeps batch identification and production records for every commercial order. We can also discuss customer-specific needs for packing, labelling and documents. Custom processing or packaging may affect the final black salt powder price.

Quality, Food Safety, and Documentation

Quality starts with choosing the right raw material. Our team checks appearance, odour, particle size, moisture and general cleanliness against the agreed specification. Handling and packing follow documented practices to limit contamination risks. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Other documents, such as batch details, the commercial invoice, packing list and export paperwork, are provided as agreed with our sales team. We do not claim certifications beyond those listed here, so please tell us at quotation stage which standards you need. For regulated markets, we review labelling and import requirements with you before dispatch. The importer remains responsible for confirming local regulations and any product registration obligations.

Applications of Black Salt Powder

Black salt powder brings saltiness and a recognisable sulphurous flavour. It works best where a product needs a savoury, egg-like or traditional South Asian taste, and it blends easily into both dry and wet recipes.
  • Chaat masala, spice blends and Indian seasoning systems
  • Fruit salads, raita, chutneys and snack toppings
  • Namkeen, extruded snacks, popcorn and savoury mixes
  • Vegan egg-style seasoning and plant-based food products
  • Instant noodles, soups, sauces and ready-to-cook meals
  • Restaurant, hotel, cloud kitchen and QSR recipes
  • Pickles, jaljeera and lemonade-style drink mixes, and culinary powders
  • Private label spice products and retail seasoning packs

Buyer Value

A consistent salt ingredient means steady production and repeatable flavour. Because it arrives as a fine powder, there is no grinding to do at your facility. Handling is quicker and recipe dosing is simpler.
  • Fair pricing for wholesale and bulk buying
  • Consistent powder texture for blending and filling lines
  • 24 month shelf life when stored dry and sealed
  • Flexible packaging for distributors, brands and manufacturers
  • Export packing support for international shipments
  • Private label and custom packaging options
  • Technical discussion on mesh and application needs
  • Direct contact with the supplier and exporter

Packaging and Shelf Life

Black salt powder is packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Standard options are 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg packs. Retail pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, bulk bags and custom printed packaging can also be arranged. Shelf life is 24 months from the manufacturing date when the product stays sealed and dry. Packaging quality, storage conditions and the destination climate all play a part. Each commercial batch carries the agreed manufacturing date, batch number, net weight, expiry information and storage instructions.

MOQ, Price, Samples, and Lead Time

What is the minimum order quantity for black salt powder price?

The MOQ for bulk black salt powder is 5 Kg. Private label, custom blends and printed packaging may need a larger quantity. We confirm the exact quantity after reviewing the packing format, destination and order volume.

How is the black salt powder price calculated?

Pricing depends on grade, quantity, packaging, labelling, documents and delivery terms. Larger wholesale orders usually work out more cost-efficient. For an accurate quote, send your quantity, packaging preference, destination country and target specification.

What is the lead time?

Lead time depends on order size, packaging, raw material availability and the documents needed. Custom packaging or large export orders take longer. We confirm the schedule in each quotation.

How can I request a sample or quote?

Contact Tradenest Naturals with your quantity, application, packaging format and delivery destination. Our team will discuss sample availability, share the product specification sheet and send a current quotation.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals supplies food ingredients to manufacturers, exporters, distributors, restaurants and private label brands. Sourcing, milling, sieving, bulk packing and export support all sit under one roof. Our team can help you compare standard and custom options. We keep specifications clear, communication practical and order coordination dependable. That makes it easier to build a stable supply programme for black salt powder and related seasoning ingredients. Whether you need wholesale black salt powder for a factory or retail-ready packs for a growing brand, we can help with the next step. Request a sample or quotation to confirm the right grade and black salt powder price for your market.
